parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can add up to 50 resource IDs in a call.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to instance.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag that is bound to the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens tag-resources --tag Value=Deep Key=team --resource-id i-50000 --resource-type instance --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ens TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'i-50000' --Tag.1.Key team --Tag.1.Value Deep --ResourceType instance
